title: The Heart Ruby
subtitle: Rubies set invisibly into a heart, ringed once in white diamond.

stone.origin: Natural rubies with brilliant-cut white diamond halo

description: Natural rubies are set invisibly into a heart-shaped cluster — no prongs, no visible metal between the stones — so the red reads as a single continuous surface rather than a group of set stones. A brilliant-cut white diamond halo rings the heart once, its cool light sharpening the edge of the form and lifting the warmth of the rubies by contrast. The invisible setting is the hardest way to build a heart and the only way to make it read this cleanly. Carried in eighteen-karat white gold.
